blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – Eastern Samar Rep. Christopher Sheen Gonzales is pushing for at least one Department of Health (DOH) tertiary hospital in every province to bring specialized medical services closer to communities outside major urban centers. Gonzales is among the five authors of House Bill 11349, or the proposed “Tertiary Hospital in Every Province Act,” which seeks to address gaps in access to specialized and critical healthcare by requiring the national government to establish or upgrade a DOH hospital in provinces without an existing facility.
